So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We're looking for an influential Staff AI Engineer to join our small AI Engineering team at Lendable to help us enable developers to move faster whilst keeping quality high.

Our mission is to bring all the lessons we have learned about AI development so far into one system so everyone can benefit. The system combines our Lendable Coding Agent, for measuring effectiveness of AI and the stability of our systems.

This is a role where you'll be working with our engineers and product managers who build our products. You will improve the developer experience and improve our throughput. You’ll see instant impact with your work and participate in a highly collaborative environment.

We need someone who takes full ownership - not just writing code, but thinking through the problem, designing the solution, shipping it, and making sure it keeps working. You'll own your work from "what should we build?" through to "is it still delivering value?"

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI tooling - building with LLMs, experimenting with new approaches, and figuring out what's possible.

What you'll be doing

Build on top of our AI cloud coding agent

  • Build the core of our AI harness

  • Enable capabilities in these agents for specification, testing, and service reliability

  • Work with security and data governance requirements to ensure the agents are secure and have access to the appropriate data

Enable others to build with AI

  • Encourage teams to level up their AI Software development processes

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience in a mid-to-large-size organisation

  • Experience of building AI tooling to improve developer experience (devex)

  • The ability to influence how people work across multiple teams

  • Proven experience building AI tooling used by others in a commercial environment

  • Strong full-stack skills in TypeScript

  • Frontend skills with Next.js or React to build an interface for engineers

  • Strong AI knowledge — LLMs, embeddings, MCPs, RAG, evals, agentic platforms

  • Experience of building infrastructure to support your systems in production using IaC, k8s or lambda functions

  • Self-starter who takes ownership end-to-end — from understanding the problem, through design and implementation, to monitoring and iteration

  • Motivated by impact — you want to see your work used and know it's making a difference

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare infrastructure

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog, Sentry, Grafana

  • Experience with creating guardrails for products: SLOs, DORA metrics

Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 

WHAT’S THE ROLE?

We’re looking for a highly experienced Principal Concept Artist to help define and elevate the visual direction of our projects.

In this role, you’ll sit at the forefront of creative development, combining exceptional artistic skill with strategic thinking and leadership. You’ll play a key role in shaping the look and feel of our worlds, working closely with Art Direction and cross‑disciplinary teams to deliver compelling, high‑quality visual experiences.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Define and guide the creation of high-quality concept art across key content areas, including characters, environments, props, and visual storytelling elements.  
    • Work closely with the Art Director to interpret and extend the project’s visual vision, translating it into clear, actionable concept direction.
      • Act as the primary concept point of contact within the project, ensuring alignment between Art Direction and concept delivery.  
        • Lead and support the concept team within the project, providing clear direction, feedback, and guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality output.
          • Mentor and develop artists at all levels, supporting progression, capability building, and leadership growth where appropriate.
            • Take creative briefs and explore a wide range of visual solutions, refining them into strong, production-ready directions.
              • Establish and communicate clear visual targets, benchmarks, and supporting material to guide concept artists and downstream teams.
                • Break down high-level creative direction into modular, production-ready concepts aligned with modelling, animation, design, and implementation requirements.
                  • Provide high-level feedback across teams, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment of concept work across all areas.
                    • Collaborate closely with design, production, and other art disciplines to ensure concept work supports gameplay, narrative, and technical constraints.
                      • Represent the concept discipline in project planning, reviews, and cross-team discussions, supporting alignment and decision-making.
                        • Support planning, scoping, and prioritisation of concept work in collaboration with Production and project leadership, ensuring alignment with delivery needs.
                          • Contribute hands-on concept work where appropriate to establish quality benchmarks and resolve complex visual challenges.
                            • Support teams in managing outsourced concept work, ensuring clear direction, effective feedback, and alignment with project standards.
                              • Identify and contribute to improvements in workflows, pipelines, documentation, and discipline practices, supporting efficiency, clarity, and quality across the project.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating expert-level concept design across multiple disciplines and styles.
    • Significant experience in senior or leadership-level concept art roles within the games industry.
      • Exceptional artistic skill, with deep understanding of anatomy, composition, perspective, lighting, and visual storytelling.
        • Proven ability to translate high-level artistic vision into clear, actionable concept direction.
          • Strong understanding of how concept art supports modelling, design, gameplay, and narrative.
            • Experience guiding and supporting teams to deliver high-quality concept work.
              • Demonstrated ability to provide clear, constructive feedback that improves quality and clarity of output.
                • Experience mentoring and developing artists, including supporting progression and capability building.
                  • Experience acting as a key point of contact or leading concept direction within a project.
                    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across disciplines.
                      • Strong problem-solving ability, able to resolve complex creative and production challenges.
                        • Experience working with outsourcing pipelines and supporting teams with external partners.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE
  • Experience working on AAA titles or complex game worlds 
    • Proficiency in 3D tools such as Blender or Maya to support concept workflows 
      • Experience contributing to cross-project or discipline-level improvements in workflows, standards, or practices 
        • Ability to work effectively across a range of artistic styles 
          • Experience supporting planning, resourcing, or project setup 
            • Experience contributing to recruitment, hiring, or team growth initiatives 

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events.

Patient Support Coordinator
description:
If you are brilliant with people, love solving problems and genuinely care about giving patients a great experience, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for a Patient Support Coordinator to join our growing team at Montu. This is a busy, hands-on role at the heart of our patient journey, supporting people who may be completely new to medical cannabis and helping make their experience with us as simple, smooth and reassuring as possible.

You will be speaking to patients every day, answering questions, coordinating appointments, supporting our clinicians and working across the business to get things sorted. Some days will be incredibly busy, priorities will change and you will need to think on your feet, so we need someone who takes ownership, stays calm and genuinely enjoys helping people.

The most important thing is the person. We can teach you our systems and processes. What we cannot teach is empathy, energy and the instinct to go that extra mile when someone needs your help.

If you are organised, proactive, great with people and want to be part of a team that is changing the way patients access medical cannabis in the UK, I would love to hear from you.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you’ll be a key part of the pharmacy team and play an important role in ensuring Montu patients and clinicians receive a seamless, high-quality service. You’ll be one of the main points of contact for patients, supporting them throughout their journey while also working closely with our clinical and operational teams.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Montu’s growing UK team and contribute to the development of our patient-facing operations. You’ll need to be organised, proactive and patient-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment.

The Patient Support Coordinator sits within the pharmacy team and requires a dynamic, patient-centric individual who is passionate about helping patients and clinicians get the best out of the service.

You’ll support the day-to-day running of the patient journey, working closely with clinicians, operations, governance, product and technology teams to ensure patients receive a smooth and professional experience.

What will you be doing?

  • Answer patient queries by telephone and email, providing clear, professional and empathetic support.

  • Schedule and coordinate patient appointments to optimise the patient experience.

  • Handle appointment payments accurately and efficiently.

  • Maintain patients’ electronic health records, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

  • Support the clinical team by:

    • Collecting patient data relating to long-term conditions.

    • Ensuring patients meet the criteria for an initial assessment in line with Montu’s inclusion and exclusion criteria.

    • Booking patients for initial and follow-up appointments.

    • Preparing for and taking minutes during multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings.

  • Support operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities.

  • Collate patient and service feedback and liaise with the Head of Governance regarding complaints and compliments.

  • Report incidents and significant events and work with the Head of Governance to support appropriate follow-up.

  • Support clinicians with operational queries and day-to-day service requirements.

  • Liaise with the Product and Tech Support teams to resolve technical issues.

  • Work closely with your line manager and the wider team to identify opportunities for service improvement.

  • Attend work-related meetings as required.

  • Maintain all mandatory training and remain familiar with company policies and SOPs.

  • Work flexibly across shifts when required.

What you need:

  • At least 2 years’ work experience.

  • Previous experience working in a healthcare environment is advantageous but not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

  • Good understanding of working within a highly regulated environment and following policies and SOPs.

  • High level of IT proficiency and confidence using multiple systems.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities and remain calm in a fast-paced environment.

  • Patient-focused, professional and proactive approach.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary.

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 37 days after one year, rising to 30 day after year 3 plus bank holidays.

  • 5% matched pension.

  • Private Health Care

  • Cycle-to-work scheme.

  • A dynamic, collaborative and supportive working environment.

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe and effective treatments while delivering an exceptional standard of care.

title: Remote Pharmacist
description:
Looking for a pharmacist role where you can focus on clinical checking without being tied to a physical pharmacy?

We are looking for a GPhC registered Pharmacist to join Montu UK on a fully remote, fixed-term contract, supporting the clinical checking of prescriptions for our growing patient community.

This is a focused, high-volume role for someone who enjoys working accurately at pace, is confident making clinical decisions and is comfortable working independently in a digital environment.

You will play an important part in keeping prescriptions moving safely and efficiently, identifying anything that needs further intervention and working with our wider pharmacy and clinical teams to resolve issues quickly.

If you are an experienced pharmacist looking for a fully remote opportunity where you can use your clinical expertise and make a genuine difference to the patient journey, we would love to hear from you.

What is the job?

Behind every prescription we dispense is a clinical check that helps ensure our patients receive their medication safely, accurately and without unnecessary delay.

As Montu continues to grow, we are looking for a Pharmacist to join our pharmacy team on a fully remote, fixed-term basis, focusing on the clinical checking of prescriptions through our online pharmacy platform.

This is a high-volume role where you will be responsible for reviewing prescriptions for clinical appropriateness and accuracy, identifying anything that requires intervention and working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to resolve issues quickly.

You will need to be confident working independently, comfortable working to clear productivity and quality expectations and able to maintain excellent clinical standards while managing a consistent volume of prescriptions.

This is a great opportunity for a pharmacist who enjoys focused clinical work, works well in a fast-moving digital environment and wants to play an important part in keeping our patients' treatment moving safely and efficiently.

What will you be doing?

You will be responsible for clinically checking prescriptions through Montu's online pharmacy system, ensuring they meet professional, clinical and regulatory requirements before progressing through the dispensing process.

You will:

  • Clinically check prescriptions accurately and efficiently using our online pharmacy platform.

  • Ensure prescriptions are reviewed and progressed within agreed SLAs and turnaround times.

  • Maintain consistent checking volumes without compromising clinical accuracy or patient safety.

  • Identify prescriptions that cannot pass clinical check and ensure the appropriate action is taken.

  • Record accurate information relating to interventions, rejected prescriptions, reasons for rejection and actions taken.

  • Work remotely with pharmacy and clinical colleagues to resolve prescription queries and discrepancies.

  • Escalate clinical or operational concerns through the appropriate channels.

  • Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks or process gaps and raise these with the relevant teams.

  • Support the timely resolution of issues to minimise delays for patients.

  • Work in accordance with Montu's SOPs, policies, clinical governance framework and professional standards.

  • Adapt to evolving systems, processes and workflows as our pharmacy continues to grow.

Working in a high-volume environment

Our pharmacy supports a large and growing number of patients, so being able to work accurately at pace is important.

You will work to clear expectations around both productivity and quality, including agreed clinical checking volumes and turnaround times.

Targets will take into account prescription complexity and the agreed operating model, but patient safety and clinical accuracy must always come first.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a qualified Pharmacist registered with the GPhC.

  • Has strong clinical judgement and excellent attention to detail.

  • Can work confidently and independently in a fully remote environment.

  • Is comfortable working within a high-volume pharmacy operation.

  • Can work to defined targets, SLAs and performance measures.

  • Is confident using digital pharmacy systems and technology.

  • Communicates clearly and works effectively with colleagues remotely.

  • Can identify problems and take a proactive approach to resolving them.

  • Adapts quickly to changes in processes, systems and ways of working.

  • Understands the importance of maintaining quality and patient safety while working efficiently.

Experience within a digital, online, high-volume or specialist pharmacy environment would be an advantage, but it is not essential.

What does success look like?

  • Maintaining consistently high clinical checking standards.

  • Completing prescription checks within agreed turnaround times.

  • Identifying and resolving issues before they cause unnecessary delays.

  • Maintaining clear and accurate records of clinical interventions.

  • Working effectively with our wider pharmacy and clinical teams.

  • Helping us identify opportunities to improve our processes as we continue to scale.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary.

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 37 days after one year, rising to 30 day after year 3 plus bank holidays.

  • 5% matched pension.

  • Private Health Care

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity

  • Cycle-to-work scheme.

  • Opportunities for learning, development and career progression.

  • A dynamic, collaborative and supportive working environment.

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients’ experiences and contribute to the growth of a forward-thinking healthcare organisation.

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines.

We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

Our pharmacy plays a critical role in that journey, ensuring patients receive their medication safely, accurately and as efficiently as possible. As we continue to grow, we are looking for brilliant pharmacy professionals who want to help us maintain those standards at scale.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Our Foundations team plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today. You'll own the hardest architectural calls, make the trade-offs that shape the platform for years, and raise the engineering bar across the company.

What you'll do

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built more than most. You've personally designed, built, and operated large-scale distributed systems in production, and you've lived with your architectural decisions long enough to know which trade-offs actually matter

  • Your impact shows up in the output of the engineers around you, not just your own commits. You make hard things look simple and teach others to do the same

  • You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day

  • You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary

Experience requirements

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems (databases, processing systems, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and a rigorous understanding of how they fail and behave under load at scale

  • Experience leading large-scale data migrations and system-splitting or re-architecture projects with real customer data on the line

  • Experience owning reliability and operations in production, including monitoring, alerting, and DevOps/SRE

  • A track record of raising engineering quality across teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring practices

  • Work smarter, not just harder.   • Breadth and depth. GTM are two of the most dynamic, data-rich functions in the business. You'll develop deep expertise in growth economics while maintaining the commercial breadth that comes from working across the full revenue engine.

  • A seat at the table early. We're at a stage where the foundations you build now will define how this company manages growth investment for years to come. The work is consequential.
